span.label: mismanaged waste sits on land until rainfall mobilises it; surface runoff both introduces new plastic to the river during heavy rain and remobilises deposited particles during floods, so input tracks the monsoon rather than the population

span.label: an artificial barrier intercepts surface plastic, so the load reaching the river mouth reflects only the catchment area downstream of the last dam - which is why moving that boundary changes the global total
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the estimate covers only the sampled size spectrum - nothing below the net mesh, nothing above the trawl aperture, nothing below the sampled depth - so it is conservative by construction
